title: The host name resolves nowhere
fault: The command names a host name that no resolver answers.
prompts: What does the client say about the name itself?
Does the name exist in any resolver you control?
hints: The name carries the .invalid top-level domain, which no resolver answers.
Examine the difference between name resolution and reachability.

reveal.wrong: The command names a name under .invalid, so no resolver can answer it.
reveal.fix: Use a name your resolver can answer, and keep practice names inside your own zone.
